title: Tenant lawsuit alleges retaliation over silica dust exposure at Littleton apartments
subject: greystar
summary: Denver7 Investigates reported that former tenant Mike Schenk sued Greystar Management Services, alleging he was evicted in retaliation for reporting silica dust from concrete sanding that coated his unit; OSHA cited the contractor more than $58,000. The eviction notice cited 'photographing the vendors without consent.' Greystar denied the allegations in court filings, saying it did not control the contractor.
status: published; underlying suit pending at time of report

title: Littleton apartment tenants describe persistent bird infestation 'nightmare'
subject: greystar
summary: Tenants said hundreds of swallows nest on Building 8 each spring, leaving droppings, dead birds and bird mites that they say enter apartments, and described unfulfilled promises from management. Greystar told 9NEWS its options are limited because the swallows are protected under the Migratory Bird Treaty Act and it is deterring nesting in compliance with federal law.

title: Frustration reaches new level after disabled man's apartment floods twice
subject: greystar
summary: KOB 4 reported that a disabled Section 8 tenant's unit at Greystar-managed Copper Hills flooded in February and again in August, leaving ceiling holes, warped cabinets and ruined furniture; he said Greystar told him it could not help because he lacked renter's insurance. KOB said the leasing office was closed during business hours and it could not reach Greystar.

title: Greystar Property Management neglecting DTLA properties, City deems SB Main uninhabitable
subject: greystar
property: SB Main (Board of Trade Building), 111 W 7th St
summary: 2UrbanGirls reported that the City of Los Angeles deemed the Greystar-managed SB Main building uninhabitable on Sept. 1, 2022 and ordered repairs by Oct. 12. Residents documented non-working elevator lighting, mold from unrepaired leaks, debris in stairwells and a front door that would not close.

title: Life at The Grand Apartments Is Anything but Grand, Tenants Say
subject: greystar
summary: Westword reported tenant accounts of floods, power outages, unsanitary conditions and property damage at the 508-unit complex behind Union Station, along with fire department involvement. Tenants said Greystar, the property manager, was unresponsive to complaints.

title: Welton Park Apartments Go More Than a Week Without Water
subject: greystar
summary: Yellow Scene reported that residents of Welton Park, managed by Greystar, went about ten days without clean running water affecting roughly 195 units, and described the outage as part of a pattern of alleged mismanagement.

title: Bellevue renter seeks assistance for growing mold problem
subject: greystar
summary: A tenant at Avana Lexington told NewsChannel 5 he no longer felt comfortable living in his apartment because of a spreading mold problem. A Greystar spokesperson said the resident had filed a work order two days earlier and the company was investigating.

title: Luxury downtown high-rise residents frustrated over building's faulty elevators
subject: greystar
summary: Residents of the Ascent at Peachtree high-rise said repeated elevator outages over several months forced them to climb multiple flights of stairs. FOX 5 said it made multiple attempts to reach Greystar, the property manager, without a response at publication.

title: 'Not fair': Elevator outages in Navy Yard high-rise upset residents
subject: greystar
summary: Residents of the 14-story Onyx on First said all three elevators had been mostly out of service for days, calling it a safety and accessibility problem. Greystar, the property manager, referred questions to the owner, which said repairs were underway and elevators were running four hours a day.

title: Students react to The Province ownership change
subject: greystar
summary: The University of Louisville student paper reported unsanitary conditions, inconsistent communication and a broken rent-payment portal as The Province transitioned from American Campus Communities to Greystar. It also noted WDRB reporting on student complaints of broken air conditioning and unsanitary conditions at Greystar-managed Trifecta Apartments.

title: Atlanta Magazine on the Avana on Main fire and the residents' lawsuit
subject: greystar
summary: In a feature on Atlanta apartment fires, Atlanta Magazine recounted the August 2020 Avana on Main fire that displaced more than 200 residents, and a now-settled residents' suit alleging an employee started it while working on rooftop HVAC units and that faulty fire alarms and expired extinguishers had gone unaddressed. The complex denied the allegations and settled with many residents; the residents' complaint (published by Law.com) named Greystar Management Services, L.P. as a defendant.
status: settled with many plaintiffs (per Atlanta Magazine)

title: Elan City Lights tenants: 'What are we going to do?'
subject: greystar
summary: After a construction crane fell onto the Greystar-owned Elan City Lights building on June 9, 2019, killing resident Kiersten Smith and injuring five others, displaced tenants described uncertainty as Greystar's hotel and daily-needs payments were set to end that Friday.

title: Old East Dallas crane collapse: Jury returns $860 million verdict against real estate developer Greystar
subject: greystar
summary: A Dallas County jury awarded more than $860 million to the family of Kiersten Smith, killed in the 2019 crane collapse, finding Greystar bore responsibility; crane supplier Bigge Crane was not found at fault. Plaintiffs argued the crane was left unable to weathervane during the storm.

title: Berkeley balcony fall victims settle with building owner
subject: greystar
summary: Victims of the June 2015 Library Gardens balcony collapse, which killed six young people (five Irish students and one from Rohnert Park) and injured seven, reached a confidential settlement with owner BlackRock and property manager Greystar. The parties agreed to adopt regular balcony-inspection policies.

title: Mass Eviction—San Jose's Largest—to Displace 670 People
subject: greystar
summary: San Jose Inside reported that the City Council voted 7-3 to deny tenant appeals and allow Greystar to demolish the 216-unit rent-controlled Reserve for a 640-unit project, displacing about 670 people in what it called possibly Silicon Valley's largest eviction. Relocation help was offered only to lower-income households (about 40 units).

title: When Private Equity Becomes Your Landlord
subject: greystar
bob-faith
summary: ProPublica's analysis of private-equity-backed apartment buyers featured tenants of San Francisco's Olume, who described soaring rents, trash in hallways and reduced security after Greystar took over in 2017 through a Freddie Mac-financed deal. The story profiles founder Bob Faith as a pioneer of connecting institutional investors with apartment buying; Greystar said resident satisfaction was 'very important.'

title: How a Secret Rent Algorithm Pushes Rents Higher
subject: greystar
summary: ProPublica's investigation of RealPage's YieldStar software, which legal experts said could enable cartel-like rent setting using competitors' private data, named Greystar among large property managers using it; RealPage marketing said Greystar outperformed its markets by 4.8% in a downturn.

title: Warren, Smith, Sanders, Markey question RealPage CEO on YieldStar landlord 'cartel'
subject: greystar
outlet: Office of U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren
summary: Four senators wrote to RealPage's CEO about whether YieldStar created a landlord 'cartel' driving up rents, noting Greystar, the largest U.S. property manager, used the software to set rents for more than 150,000 apartments.

title: Senators Push DOJ To Crack Down On RealPage-Led Rent Inflation
subject: greystar
summary: Bisnow reported that Sens. Warren, Smith, Sanders and Markey urged the DOJ Antitrust Division to investigate RealPage's rent-setting algorithm, citing large users including Greystar.

title: Despite CDC moratorium, corporate landlords have gone on eviction spree
subject: greystar
summary: Raw Story reported eviction-tracking data showing that corporate landlords including Invitation Homes, MAA and Greystar were among those filing the most evictions after the September 2020 CDC eviction moratorium was announced.

title: Class Action Lawsuit Targets Colorado's Largest Apartment Management Company Over 'Junk Fees'
subject: greystar
summary: Coverage of a proposed class action filed in Denver District Court by tenant Nichole Collins, alleging Greystar charged undisclosed mandatory fees for pest control, valet trash and billing (nearly $40/month) not included in advertised rent. Represented by Towards Justice and Justice for the People Legal Center.

title: Colorado family charged $4,000 in fees after loved one dies unexpectedly, landlord says death meant she broke her lease
subject: greystar
summary: After tenant Leticia Farrer died in January 2024, her family was billed about $4,140 in early-termination and concession fees at the Greystar-managed Avenida; the lease said tenants were not released 'for any reason, including death.' Greystar cleared the balance after the story; Colorado later passed 'Letty's Act' (HB25-1108) to bar such fees.

title: Tenant issues warning on major property management company
subject: greystar
summary: The Daily Dot covered a viral TikTok (over 323,000 views) in which a tenant identified as B. called Greystar 'one of the worst property management companies' she had encountered and said she wanted to break her 15-month lease within 30 days over unenforced policies.

title: Charlotte tenant sues over water damage at Greystar-managed luxury tower
subject: greystar
summary: WCNC reported a SkyHouse Uptown tenant's repeated water-damage incidents and her description of 'a lackadaisical approach from management'; she sued Greystar in 2022 alleging failure to perform necessary maintenance.

title: Greystar Facing FTC Lawsuit Over Hidden Renter Fees
subject: greystar
summary: Bisnow relayed a Wall Street Journal report that the FTC was preparing to sue Greystar over mandatory fees for items such as pest control, trash and background checks that were not disclosed in advertised rents.

title: DOJ Sues Large U.S. Landlords Over Alleged Price-Fixing
subject: greystar
summary: ProPublica reported that the Justice Department expanded its RealPage antitrust case to sue six large landlords including Greystar, alleging they shared competitively sensitive data to align rents.

title: Apartment giant Greystar accused of charging 'hidden fees' to tenants around U.S.
subject: greystar
summary: The Review-Journal reported on federal and Colorado allegations that Greystar engaged in deceptive advertising by omitting mandatory fees from advertised rents, including at Nevada properties.

title: SC-based apartment giant settles suit over inflated rents
subject: greystar
summary: Greystar's hometown paper reported that the Charleston-based company agreed to settle a federal lawsuit alleging it worked with other landlords to keep rents high, and examined the possible effect on prices.

title: DOJ: Greystar to Stop Using 'Anticompetitive' Rent-Setting Software
subject: greystar
summary: ProPublica reported Greystar's proposed DOJ settlement barring it from algorithms that rely on rivals' nonpublic data and from sharing such data, resolving claims it colluded to raise rents; the story linked the case to ProPublica's 2022 RealPage investigation. Greystar admitted no wrongdoing.
status: proposed settlement, subject to court approval

title: Major landlord reaches $7M settlement with California, other states in alleged rent price scheme
subject: greystar
summary: The Long Beach Post reported Greystar's roughly $7 million settlement with California and other states over its alleged role in an algorithmic rent-pricing scheme.

title: 'Scammed out of £20k': London students forced to move out of 'most exclusive' student hall
subject: greystar
summary: Residents of Chapter London Bridge, a premium student hall run by Greystar's Chapter brand, had to vacate after a major water leak caused a power outage in December 2025, with restoration expected to take until at least May 2026; students also cited earlier problems with lifts, water, electrics and a broken rubbish chute. One student said she felt 'scammed out of £20,000'; Chapter offered rooms at its other sites.

title: Greystar settlement will result in refunds for some Arizona renters
subject: greystar
summary: The Copper Courier reported that Arizona renters could recoup money paid to Greystar for hidden and junk fees from $1.6 million in settlements involving two Phoenix-area complexes.

title: 'Extremely overwhelmed': apartment renters face rising tide of fees
subject: greystar
summary: A Guardian investigation by Tracie McMillan counted at least 125 differently named fees at Greystar properties (e.g., boiler management, refrigerant, 'solar rebill' and 'lifestyle' fees) and reported tenant complaints of 'unfair' and 'inflated' charges, plus pending fee class actions in several states. Greystar denied the claims.

title: The hidden costs of renting in metro Detroit
subject: greystar
summary: WDET's The Metro interviewed Guardian reporter Tracie McMillan about her investigation into fees charged at Greystar-managed apartments and how they affect metro Detroit renters.

title: Report looks at rise of 'junk fees' renters face at apartments managed by Greystar
subject: greystar
summary: Texas Standard discussed the Guardian's findings of 125 named fees at Greystar listings, noting Greystar manages about 200,000 units in Texas and that some leases carry five to eleven mandatory fees on top of rent.

title: Greystar Accused By Watchdog Of Discriminating Against Section 8 Voucher Users
subject: greystar
summary: Bisnow reported that Housing Rights Initiative filed complaints alleging Greystar properties refused or illegally conditioned housing-voucher applicants in jurisdictions with source-of-income protections, based on undercover testing.

title: Greystar faces 114 housing voucher discrimination complaints
subject: greystar
summary: HousingWire reported HRI's 114 complaints in Virginia, California, Maryland, Hawaii, Michigan, New Jersey and D.C. alleging testers were told vouchers were not accepted, had to cover 100% of rent, or would not count toward income minimums. Greystar said it is committed to fair housing.

title: Largest landlord in the US accused of civil rights violations
subject: greystar
summary: The Guardian reported fair housing complaints accusing Greystar of refusing tenants who use federal Housing Choice Vouchers in places where that is illegal, alleging 114 violations across six states and D.C.

title: Wailuku Greystar property named in statewide housing voucher discrimination complaint
subject: greystar
summary: Maui Now reported that a Greystar property in Wailuku was among those named in Hawaii housing-voucher discrimination complaints filed by Housing Rights Initiative.

title: National landlord with property in Virginia accused of housing discrimination
subject: greystar
summary: Virginia Mercury reported HRI complaints alleging Greystar-managed properties in Virginia refused or illegally conditioned housing-voucher applicants despite state source-of-income protections.

title: Major Landlord Accused Of Discriminating Against Section 8 Renters In Hawaii
subject: greystar
summary: Civil Beat reported that testers sent by a nonprofit were told by agents for Greystar that their vouchers would not work, in alleged violation of Hawaii's source-of-income protections.

title: These are the real estate execs Trump tapped to help restart the economy
subject: bob-faith
summary: The Real Deal reported that Robert Faith of Greystar was named to the real estate panel of President Trump's Great American Economic Revival Industry Groups in April 2020, alongside executives such as Blackstone's Jonathan Gray and Related's Stephen Ross. (Factual record of an advisory appointment; no allegation of wrongdoing.)

title: Greystar, the Largest Corporate Landlord in the US, Has a Shocking Track Record
subject: greystar
bob-faith
outlet: Housing Is A Human Right (AIDS Healthcare Foundation advocacy site)
summary: An advocacy piece compiling Greystar controversies under Bob Faith, including the RealPage price-fixing litigation, the FTC/Colorado hidden-fee case and fair housing complaints. Advocacy source; underlying claims should be checked against primary records.
